segments.en: We learned in the mishna: «These are» the breaks «between the paragraphs» at which one is permitted to interrupt under certain circumstances. According to the first tanna, one may interrupt between the last paragraph of Shema and the blessing that follows it, but Rabbi Yehuda prohibits this.
